description: Defines a generic ring buffer data structure with support for different internal storage types (std::vector and std::array), including specializations for power-of-two sizes to optimize wrap-around calculations. Includes classes for buffer management, iteration, and operations like push, pop, and access.

classes.name: ring_buffer_storage<std::array<T, N>, ForcePower2Size>
classes.description: Specialized storage class for fixed-size ring buffer using std::array, optimized for power-of-two sizes.

classes.name: ring_buffer_storage<std::vector<T>, false>
classes.description: Storage class for dynamic-size ring buffer using std::vector, with support for resizing.

classes.name: ring_buffer_storage<std::vector<T>, true>
classes.description: Optimized storage class for power-of-two sized std::vector ring buffer, avoiding modulo operation.

classes.name: ring_buffer_impl<T, Container, ForcePower2Size>
classes.description: Main ring buffer class implementing queue-like behavior with iterator support, for both static and dynamic storage.

methods.name: advance_pos
methods.description: Calculates the next position in the ring buffer, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer, with behavior depending on static or dynamic storage.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an element to the ring buffer, asserting if full.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the oldest element from the ring buffer.

methods.name: top
methods.description: Returns the most recently added element.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the buffer.
